about_the_game:
About This Game

Flick it. Buff it. Brawl it.

Jump into the ridiculous world of Pinch N Roll, an online physics-based brawler where you and up to 10 players take control of customizable beans and fight it out across wild arenas. It’s fast, it’s chaotic, and it’s all about flicking your bean to victory.

Key Features:

  • Bean-Based Mayhem – Launch yourself, bounce off walls, and collide with friends in hilarious physics-driven battles.

  • Over 20 Unique Arenas – From wacky arenas to dangerous traps, no two matches ever feel the same.

  • 20+ Buffs to Experiment With – Power up with bizarre upgrades that stack and transform your bean into a true menace.

  • Customization Galore – Unlock hats, eyes, tattoos, and hairstyles to create your ultimate bean look.

  • Collect Blue & Golden Balls – Earn rewards from victories and use them to unlock new cosmetic items.

  • Cartoony Chaos with a Dash of Adult Humor – Lighthearted, cheeky fun that doesn’t take itself too seriously.

Whether you’re teaming up with friends or going all-out solo, Pinch N Roll delivers unpredictable matches full of laughter, last-second saves, and bean-flavored bragging rights.
